acceptanceCriteria.text: Define a coherent, exhaustive product-level capability taxonomy that traces every Product Canon experience, responsibility, completion rule, and success measure to explicit capabilities.
Give each capability a stable identifier, clear user-visible responsibility, and outcome-based completion evidence; distinguish capability, cross-cutting invariant, and later design decision.

Define cross-capability lifecycle and dependency relationships, including objective-to-completion, dependency-driven autonomy, integrated verification, authority, recovery, and truthful blocked/unverified state.
Specify representative end-to-end acceptance scenarios and failure/uncertainty cases without introducing implementation commitments.
Delimit human vs delegated responsibility, product boundaries, non-goals, and the architectural questions explicitly deferred to Phase 3.

Publish the English capability model in the repository's normative documentation category, link it from that category's index, and create a ready-for-review PR. No product code, tests, CI, or existing architectural contracts are modified.

issue.title: docs: define implementation-independent product capability model
